name: cold shock domain containing E1

function.text: CSDE1 encodes cold shock domain-containing protein E1. Annotated molecular activities include protein-RNA adaptor activity and lncRNA binding. It participates in CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization and male gonad development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
